sampdoria-pio-brace-zero-xg-jan21-2029: CurvaB
Three goals and 0.0 xG conceded. I know xG is not shots, but that is still a ridiculous level of control.
TacticalNonno
Sampdoria were not literally shotless; the point is that none of their efforts registered meaningful xG. Napoli controlled the dangerous areas.
PioNation
That first-time Pio finish off the post is going straight into the season montage.
AzzurriAlSud
Davies deserves to be in the same clip. The turn and pass made the finish possible.
PazEnjoyer
Paz leaves with a goal and an assist and somehow Pio will still own every headline.
BeierHive
He can share one. Beier came on and created Paz's goal too. This squad is absurd.
PartenopeiForever
Roma on 52, Napoli on 55. I am celebrating the performance and staring at the table at the same time.
NapoliTherapy
My television has the match replay. My phone has the standings. This is not healthy.
SaladinoOutNow
Only three goals against a side that produced 0.0 xG? A ruthless manager wins 8–0.
CurvaB
Sampdoria barely threatened and we scored three. Are you genuinely angry that the scoreboard didn't reach your imaginary quota of eight?
sampdoria-paz-pio-beier-jan21-2029: PazEnjoyer
Paz deserves his own headline here. He scored, created and kept appearing between the lines instead of merely orbiting Pio's performance.
PioNation
I am not taking a single touch away from Paz. But Pio's timing to meet that Davies move was a striker's contribution too.
BeierHive
Beier replacing Pio and then setting up Paz is exactly why squad depth matters in January.
TacticalNonno
Beier didn't just replace Pio's minutes; his movement gave Paz a different passing lane. That is why I keep asking people to judge substitutions by what changes.
CurvaB
Davies, Paz, Pio, Beier. Four different attacking stories in one comfortable afternoon.
PartenopeiForever
That is what champions need when the schedule starts chewing through legs.
CalcioArchivist
The useful record here is simple: Paz goal and assist, Pio brace, Beier assist off the bench. Keep the roles straight.
NapoliTherapy
Thank you. I have seen three people give Paz an assist he did not get.
SaladinoOutNow
Paz needed a goal AND assist because the manager has clearly failed to coach modesty.
PazEnjoyer
I am begging the moderators to suspend you until Juventus.
sampdoria-zero-xg-tactical-jan21-2029: 0.0 xG against says more about where Sampdoria were allowed to shoot from than whether they literally attempted nothing.
Thank you. The number is impressive enough without turning it into a fake zero-shot claim.
The part I loved was that the game never became chaotic after Napoli went ahead.
Three goals at one end, no meaningful chance quality at the other. That is control.
A keeper will happily take a match where the defence keeps the dangerous work away from him.
And the whole unit gets credit, not just whoever happened to wear the gloves.
I watched a Napoli match without feeling my heart stop in the last ten minutes. Historic.
The opposition xG rounded to zero because our manager is suppressing entertainment.
This account remains the strongest argument against universal internet access.
roma-52-napoli-55-juventus-47-jan21-2029: CurvaB
Three points over Roma, eight over Juventus. Nobody speak to me about comfort.
NapoliTherapy
Correct. I will consider comfort sometime in June.
RomaSud
Enjoy the lead. Three points is not a title.
PartenopeiForever
Nobody said it was. We are enjoying being the ones three points ahead.
CalcioArchivist
The table is why the Sampdoria result mattered as much as the performance. Napoli did their job while pressure stayed on.
TacticalNonno
And that pressure changes every decision about rotation from here.
PioNation
If Pio keeps producing, Roma can score all the goals they want. We just need our points.
SouthStandAnalyst
Careful. A title race is not a striker contest. The defensive numbers matter too.
SaladinoOutNow
Eight points above Juventus is concerning. They are clearly luring us into complacency.
CurvaB
I hope they lure us into another eight-point cushion.
bellandi-sampdoria-critique-jan21-2029: BellandiReceipts
Bellandi found criticism after a 3–0. I respect the commitment to the bit.
TacticalNonno
There is always something to improve. The problem is pretending improvement and satisfaction cannot coexist.
CurvaB
If your first reaction to three goals and 0.0 xG conceded is annoyance, football may not be for you.
NapoliTherapy
Some of us are trying very hard to enjoy one peaceful Sunday.
PioNation
He can critique the finishing all he wants. Pio still walked away with two.
BeierHive
And Beier still affected the match from the bench. The attack did its job.
CalcioArchivist
Criticism is fine when it stays attached to confirmed events. No invented defensive errors, no mystery assists.
SouthStandAnalyst
That is the standard: argue about what actually happened. A 3–0 win gives us enough football to debate without inventing mistakes.
SaladinoOutNow
Finally, a journalist brave enough to understand that winning 3–0 is merely a different form of failure.
CurvaB
Of course you found your soulmate.
fiorentina-nil-nil-gap-one-24: CurvaB
Still first, but that 0–0 feels awful because Roma are now breathing on our necks.
NapoliTherapy
One point ahead has never felt so small.
TacticalNonno
The clean sheet is valuable. The sixth draw is the concern. Both belong in the same assessment.
SouthStandAnalyst
The sixth draw matters because control without a goal still leaves two points on the table. Roma being one point back makes every sterile spell expensive.
PioNation
Do not turn one scoreless game into a referendum on Pio or Beier.
BeierHive
Especially when we do not have the chance data to know who actually missed what.
RomaSud
Fifty-six points. We can see you.
CurvaB
And fifty-seven is still larger than fifty-six. See you in the run-in.
SaladinoOutNow
A 0–0 while top of the league. The collapse is complete.
NapoliTherapy
You have been predicting the collapse since August. Please predict a lottery number instead.
roma-one-point-behind-24: Napoli 57, Roma 56. I have refreshed the table enough times to wear out my screen.
Stop refreshing. It remains one point and it remains terrifying.
Roma have scored more; Napoli have conceded far fewer. Two very different title profiles separated by one point.
That is why the head-to-head feels enormous. Strength against strength.
Nine more goals scored and one point behind. We are coming.
And Napoli's defensive record is the counterargument. This is why the table is interesting.
I wanted a comfortable defence of the title. Apparently the football gods laughed.
They heard you ask for entertainment.
Being only one point ahead is proof the manager has failed to be twelve points ahead.
napoli-defence-12-conceded-24: MeretUnion
Twelve conceded in twenty-four league matches. Give the back line its flowers.
TacticalNonno
Half a goal per match is a championship foundation, full stop.
CurvaB
The defence is elite. I just wish the attack had turned two of these draws into wins.
PioNation
That is fair. Praise one unit without using it to attack another player.
SouthStandAnalyst
Roma have scored more, Napoli have conceded much less. The title race is basically an argument about which advantage holds.
RomaSud
We know which one I am choosing.
CurvaB
And we know which one the current table is choosing.
CalcioArchivist
A clean sheet at Fiorentina was not worthless. It simply was not enough to create breathing room.
NapoliTherapy
That sentence is the exact source of my frustration.
SaladinoOutNow
Twelve conceded? Should be zero. Sack the defensive staff.
MeretUnion
I respect your commitment to impossible standards.
pio-beier-scoreless-fiorentina: PioNation
One 0–0 does not erase what Pio and Beier have done all season.
BeierHive
Or what they did together in Rome. Partnerships are judged across months, not one afternoon.
TacticalNonno
If opponents are adapting to the pair, that is the next tactical question—not 'which striker failed?'
SouthStandAnalyst
Especially without shot locations or chance quality from this match.
CurvaB
I wanted one of them to steal it late. I am still not turning on either of them.
NapoliTherapy
Correct. I reserve my irrational anger for the table.
CalcioArchivist
Tracked tallies are impressive, but tonight's confirmed fact is simply that Napoli did not score.
PioNation
The record already tells the story: Napoli failed to score. We do not need to invent which striker supposedly wasted which chance.
SaladinoOutNow
Two forwards failed to score in one match. Sell both before breakfast.
BeierHive
You would replace them with a traffic cone and complain it did not press.
bellandi-fiorentina-one-point: I hate that Bellandi is right about the gap. One point is nothing.
One point is also first place. I will cling to that until kickoff.
His useful point is about accumulation: six draws are not disasters individually, but collectively they shrink margins.
That is criticism with actual substance.
Keep saying first place. We only need one slip.
The defence has carried us through days when the attack has not. That matters in a title race.
Twelve conceded says it better than any adjective.
Bellandi criticising the manager means journalism has finally healed.
Do not drag us into your agenda.
bologna-comeback-25: CurvaB
Pio at 75. Beier at 83. I went from funeral silence to waking the entire building.
NapoliTherapy
My neighbour knocked on the wall after the winner. I knocked back twice.
PioNation
Beier assists Pio, then Pio assists Beier. That partnership dragged three points out of a nightmare.
BeierHive
And neither one needed to be the hero alone. That is the best part.
TacticalNonno
Celebrate the comeback, then study why Bologna were allowed to put Napoli in that position.
CurvaB
Tomorrow, Nonno. Tonight I am replaying 75 and 83.
RomaSud
You escaped. Do not pretend otherwise.
PartenopeiForever
We escaped with three points. In a title race, that distinction is beautiful.
SaladinoOutNow
Scoring twice late shows the manager irresponsibly failed to score twice early.
NapoliTherapy
This is somehow your most coherent complaint.
roma-59-juventus-54: Roma won again. One point. Thirteen matches. I am exhausted.
The title race is now a weekly medical condition.
Juventus at 54 cannot be ignored either. Six points is useful, not decisive.
Three clubs still have reasons to believe. That is the table.
Sixty for Napoli, fifty-nine for Roma. We are not going anywhere.
Every Napoli win feels followed immediately by checking what Roma did.
I miss celebrating for more than twelve seconds.
Leading the league by one point is cowardly. Lead by twenty.
We will forward your tactical plan.
beier-pio-two-way: They literally swapped jobs: Beier made Pio's goal, Pio made Beier's. That is chemistry.
And it matters because defenders cannot decide which one is the finisher.
A two-way partnership is harder to mark than a fixed nine-plus-provider relationship.
Especially when both are comfortable attacking the final ball.
I do not care who gets the headline. Those two rescued the match together.
That sentence should be the headline.
Their tracked totals are outrageous, but the sequence at Bologna is enough evidence without inflating anything.
Seventy-fifth and eighty-third. I know them by heart already.
Two forwards assisting each other is suspicious cooperation. Investigate.
napoli-13-conceded: Thirteen conceded in twenty-five matches remains absurdly good.
And yet conceding first at Bologna shows why aggregate numbers cannot answer every match-level question.
This defence gives us permission to survive bad attacking spells. Today the forwards paid them back.
That is what a full team does over a season.
Roma score more; Napoli concede less. We keep arriving at the same strategic contrast because it is real.
Only thirteen conceded and I still panic every time the opponent crosses halfway.
That sounds like a you problem.
Thirteen goals allowed is thirteen managerial resignations overdue.
You must be exhausted typing this every week.
bellandi-bologna-steal: BellandiReceipts
Calling it a steal is fair. Pretending a steal is worth fewer than three points is not.
TacticalNonno
Bellandi can call the performance poor and the standings can still show three more points. Both statements survive the final whistle.
CurvaB
I will take ugly, late and emotionally irresponsible if it ends with Pio and Beier turning the game.
NapoliTherapy
Please do not make 'emotionally irresponsible' our club identity.
SouthStandAnalyst
The comeback should not erase the first seventy-four minutes. The first seventy-four should not erase the comeback either.
PartenopeiForever
You can keep the balanced assessment. I was silent for seventy-four minutes and then Pio and Beier gave me permission to lose my mind.
RomaSud
You were minutes from dropping points.
CurvaB
And then we did not. That is why you are annoyed.
SaladinoOutNow
Bellandi called it a steal. I call it evidence for a tribunal.
BellandiReceipts
Nobody invited you to the press box.
palermo-roma-shock-md26: ROMA CONCEDED FOUR. Palermo, I owe your entire city dinner.
I knew opening this thread was a mistake.
Stay. We have several thank-you speeches prepared.
The important part is that Napoli won their own match first. A rival dropping points only matters if you collect yours.
Napoli handled their own business first; Palermo's result then turned a one-point race into four. That sequencing matters.
Four points is breathing room, not permission to relax. Roma are next.
I was happy for seven minutes before remembering that.
There are weekends where a title race changes shape. This feels like one.
Potentially. The head-to-head next will tell us how permanent the change is.
Depending on Palermo to help is unacceptable. The manager should have personally stopped Roma scoring all season.
pio-peacock-empoli-md26: PioNation
Pio attacks the rebound like a striker who expects the ball to stay alive. That is pure number-nine instinct.
CurvaB
And the finish off the post still made my heart stop before it went in.
MeretUnion
Eight saves for Peacock deserves respect without turning it into a goalkeeper civil war.
PeacockWatch
Eight saves is enough to celebrate Peacock. Turning it into an attack on Meret would make the discussion smaller, not sharper.
StachWatch
Stach deserves his share of the second goal conversation.
CalcioArchivist
Pio owns the finish, but Stach's work belongs in the sequence too. Good archives remember the move, not only the scorer.
TacticalNonno
A rotated side winning while the goalkeeper is busy tells you two things: the depth delivered, and the match was not as comfortable as the score might suggest.
NapoliTherapy
There. That is why eight saves made me sweat.
SaladinoOutNow
Eight saves means the manager forced Peacock to work eight times. Workplace violation.
PeacockWatch
Please never become a union representative.
peacock-eight-saves-empoli: Eight saves. No need to turn every one into a miracle; making the routine ones is part of the job.
And making all eight is still an excellent afternoon.
This is a better goalkeeper discussion than 'starter good, backup bad.' Form, workload and opponent matter.
And one performance can earn more trust without settling the hierarchy forever.
I love that Peacock got his chance and made it impossible to ignore.
I love that the clean sheet prevented my usual final-ten-minute breakdown.
The confirmed number is eight saves. That is enough to praise without inventing eight spectacular chances.
Eight confirmed saves already make the case. Calling all eight miraculous would only make the real performance less credible.
Eight saves proves the keeper is selfishly hoarding saves from teammates.
roma-napoli-next-fixture-md26: Roma next with a four-point cushion. The stadium is going to sound feral.
Four points behind and coming to Naples? Roma have every reason to attack the occasion instead of treating it like damage limitation.
A draw preserves four. A Napoli win makes seven. That changes the risk profile for both teams.
And Roma's need to chase could create spaces Napoli did not see at Fiorentina.
I want Pio in the middle of this match. Big forwards need big nights.
And I want Beier dragging defenders away from him. Do not make it one-player theatre.
Palermo gave me joy and immediately handed me the most stressful fixture imaginable.
Palermo gave us seven minutes of peace and then the Roma fixture appeared in my head again. This race charges interest on joy.
Anything less than an eleven-point swing in one match will be disappointing.
palermo-fans-column-md26: Grazie Palermo. I am serious. Somebody send flowers.
Keep the flowers. Just beat Roma again for us someday.
I opened the Aglianico before remembering we still have to play Roma next.
Put the cork back in halfway. Responsible title-race drinking.
This is why football makes alliances that last exactly one weekend.
I hate every one of you.
Enjoy the rival result, but Pio and Peacock earned Napoli's own points. Never outsource your title race.
That should be the closing line of the column.
Palermo have now contributed more to the title than the manager. Sack him and appoint Palermo.
monaco-away-four-nil-ucl: CurvaB
A hat-trick before halftime away in Europe. I barely had time to sit down between goals.
PioNation
Pio was ruthless. Monaco never got to turn the tie into a long night.
ScotsInNaples
McTominay with two assists. SCOTTISH SERVICE EXPORTS.
TacticalNonno
Two final balls in a knockout away leg is an enormous contribution.
BeierHive
Beier and Pio together are becoming unfair.
PioNation
Different matches, same problem for defenders: track one and the other appears.
SouthStandAnalyst
Four-nil away is the kind of first-leg margin that lets you manage the return intelligently.
NapoliTherapy
Please do not say 'comfortable' until the second leg is over.
SaladinoOutNow
Winning by four away has destroyed suspense. Anti-entertainment football.
CurvaB
I will personally survive the lack of suspense.
forest-draw-march29: Forest. I wanted a European night with atmosphere and apparently I got my wish.
You did. Do not arrive expecting a sightseeing trip.
First leg at home, second away. Napoli have to build an advantage without becoming reckless.
Especially after Monaco. A different opponent means the last tie proves nothing by itself.
Pio in this form against anybody makes me believe.
Forest should want Napoli confident. Knockout nights are better when both sides arrive convinced they can hurt the other.
March 6 is already circled and my stomach already hurts.
Drawing Forest instead of an imaginary easier opponent shows poor management of the draw ceremony.
At last, accountability reaches random balls in bowls.
monaco-qualified-march29: CurvaB
Five-one on aggregate. Job done. Next page.
NapoliTherapy
After Bamba's early goal I briefly forgot the first-leg score and panicked anyway.
PioNation
Four goals across the tie for Pio. He owned this matchup.
BeierHive
And the Neves-to-Beier-to-Pio combination in the return was gorgeous.
TacticalNonno
The second leg did not need heroics. It needed the tie managed after the early scare.
SouthStandAnalyst
That is maturity: respond, restore control, advance.
PartenopeiForever
European knockout wins still feel special. I refuse to become used to them.
CurvaB
We spent too many years dreaming about nights like these to treat a European knockout win as routine now.
SaladinoOutNow
Only 5–1 on aggregate. Standards are collapsing.
PioNation
He scored four of them. What do you want, a fifth personally delivered to your house?
lazio-coppa-feb27: Lazio in the cup while the league race is this tight. Fantastic. My blood pressure thanks nobody.
Rotation matters here, but so does respecting a knockout opponent. You cannot treat the cup as recovery training.
The balance is the whole story.
I want the league. I want Europe. I also want the Coppa. Greed has arrived.
Do not invent a lineup before it exists. The schedule pressure is enough to discuss.
Thank you. Selection debate needs actual selections.
If the manager rotates, reckless. If he does not, reckless. I have prepared both posts.
At least you admit it now.
march-fixture-list-2029: Parma, Forest, Como, Forest, internationals around it, then Bergamo. Who designed this calendar?
Someone who hates hamstrings and sleep.
Parma, Forest twice, Como, internationals and then Bergamo: March will expose any position where the rotation is only theoretical.
And that includes the goalkeepers. Do not be surprised if Peacock matters.
My only request is that Pio emerges from March with both legs attached.
Keep Maxi healthy too. Losing either half of the Pio-Beier partnership before this run would change how every opponent can defend Napoli.
One opponent slot was still unclear when this was written, so keep the uncertainty in the archive.
Leave the uncertainty in the archive. A historical page should show what supporters knew then, not what we learned later.
The manager has failed to move March to a quieter month.
forest-opinion-2029: CurvaB
Respect Forest, fear nobody. That is where I am.
ForestAway
Respect is enough. If Napoli arrived frightened of Forest before the ball was kicked, we would take that as an invitation.
TacticalNonno
Knockout ties punish arrogance faster than league matches. Monaco's aggregate score does not travel into this round.
SouthStandAnalyst
Monaco's 5–1 aggregate score buys nothing against Forest. New opponent, new problems, 0–0 when the whistle goes.
PioNation
If Pio and Beier get chances, Forest will have problems.
ForestAway
And if our forwards get chances, so will Napoli. That is why we play it.
PartenopeiForever
These European nights are why you endure all the ordinary Tuesdays.
CurvaB
There are no ordinary Tuesdays in this season.
SaladinoOutNow
Forest have trees. Trees are tall. Set-piece danger. Sack the manager pre-emptively.
TacticalNonno
I wish I could unread tactical forestry.
napoli-roma-next-scudetto-md27: Roma next. Win and the gap becomes seven. I have been thinking about nothing else.
And lose and it is one. Do not leave that half of the equation out.
That swing is why the match will feel larger than three points without literally being worth more than three.
A win would still award only three points, but moving seven clear could alter how both teams approach every remaining match.
I want Pio ready for the biggest domestic night of the season so far.
And I want defenders worrying about more than just Pio. The front line has to make Roma choose.
Thirteen conceded all season and I am still convinced Roma will score with their first touch.
Seven clear if we win? Should be seventeen. Poor season planning.
Please save your resignation letter for after kickoff.
napoli-roma-opinion-md27: Thank Palermo, then forget Palermo. This match has to be about Napoli taking control of its own race.
Palermo created the opportunity; Napoli still have to face Roma themselves. The title race cannot be outsourced.
You sound very confident for a fanbase that was terrified of a one-point gap last week.
Roma's scoring record and Napoli's defensive record make this a fascinating clash of season identities.
And the table gives both sides a very different incentive structure.
If Napoli win: seven clear. If Roma win: one. That is the cleanest way to explain the stakes.
And the worst way to help me sleep.
A defining match is irresponsible scheduling. The manager should have defined the season earlier.
I almost respect this account now.
juventus-beier-hattrick-oct2029: CurvaB
Down after fifteen minutes in Turin and then Beier scores three. That is a statement, not just a comeback.
JuventinoAway
It felt like the first goal woke Napoli up instead of rattling them.
BeierHive
Pio supplying two of the goals is what makes the hat-trick even better. The forwards are feeding each other instead of competing for the headline.
PioNation
Two assists while Maxi scores three. I am saving this match for the next person who calls Pio selfish.
TacticalNonno
The 3.9 xG matters because the score was not a smash-and-grab. Napoli kept creating after the equaliser.
SouthStandAnalyst
Juventus scored first, but Napoli kept creating instead of retreating. The 3.9 xG is why this felt like a takeover, not an escape.
NapoliTherapy
I spent eleven minutes preparing an angry halftime speech and then Beier rendered it obsolete.
CurvaB
Keep it saved. This team will give you another opportunity.
SaladinoOutNow
Conceding first was an unacceptable delay in the hat-trick schedule.
BeierHive
He finished it by the 55th minute. How much faster do you need?
pio-milan-brace-2029: PioNation
Four goals in two matches for Pio and these two against Milan were ice-cold.
CurvaB
The second one into the top corner was the moment Milan looked finished.
BeierHive
Two assists for Maxi and then he scores the third himself. That is a complete forward performance.
ScotsInNaples
And McTominay gets the final assist. Scotland appears in the box score, as required.
PazEnjoyer
Paz starts both Pio goals and people will skip over him because the official assist belongs to Beier.
TacticalNonno
Which is why buildup matters. The last pass is not the only creative action.
NapoliTherapy
A 3–0 against Milan where I was not terrified in stoppage time? I do not recognise this sport.
CurvaB
Do not get used to peace.
SaladinoOutNow
Pio scoring twice has selfishly denied us a striker crisis.
PioNation
You can manufacture one from anything. I believe in you.
milan-passing-triangle-2029: TacticalNonno
Paz to Beier to Pio twice is the sort of repeated pattern opponents have to solve, not dismiss as coincidence.
SouthStandAnalyst
Especially because the same three roles appeared twice at different moments.
PazEnjoyer
This is why I keep defending Paz when people only read goals and assists. He breaks the line before the assist exists.
BeierHive
Then Maxi makes the right final pass. Everyone in the chain deserves credit.
PioNation

leverkusen-defence-opinion-sep-2028.text: We're actually debating whether a 90+2 leveller was good because we are so ambitious now.

replies.text: Ambition raises standards. It shouldn't erase wonder.

leverkusen-defence-opinion-sep-2028.text: Quattro punti in Europa. Beier ci ha salvati. Ora sistemiamo quella difesa.

replies.text: Finally, something I can believe in for five minutes.

milan-san-siro-beier-91-match-report-oct.text: NOVANTUNESIMO. A SAN SIRO. SOTTO LA PIOGGIA. NON SVEGLIATEMI.

replies.text: Please, my heart is still trying to return to normal.
Domani? Io punto a giovedì. Quel novantunesimo mi ha distrutto.

milan-san-siro-beier-91-match-report-oct.text: He did it at Como in the 88th. Leverkusen in the 92nd. Now at San Siro in the 91st. Give the man his own timezone.

replies.text: Beier Standard Time runs permanently three minutes after everyone else.
Maybe score earlier for once?

milan-san-siro-beier-91-match-report-oct.text: TWO ASSISTS AGAINST MILAN AWAY. That is not an assist merchant. That is a distribution centre.

replies.text: First to our boy Pio.
Then the delivery marked urgent at 90+1.

milan-san-siro-beier-91-match-report-oct.text: PIO! Dopo il fuorigioco e la parata, non ha mollato un centimetro. E al 68 ci ha rimessi in piedi.

replies.text: La pazienza di un centravanti. Il gol che vale tutto.

milan-san-siro-beier-91-match-report-oct.text: Maignan fa due miracoli, andiamo avanti con Rabiot e perdiamo al novantunesimo. Non ho parole.

replies.text: Un abbraccio, ma i tre punti vengono a Napoli.
È una beffa totale.

milan-san-siro-beier-91-match-report-oct.text: At 55 I was writing another thread about how we cannot keep scoring late. At 91 I threw the thread away. Again.

replies.text: You have an entire recycling business now.
Please start writing that thread at kickoff every week.

milan-san-siro-beier-91-match-report-oct.text: Everyone is screaming but I want to know why we needed the 91st minute after all those first-half chances.

replies.text: Because Maignan is a very good goalkeeper. You watched the game, right?
The question is fair. Your conclusion is probably already typed.

milan-san-siro-beier-91-match-report-oct.text: La parata di Maignan su Nico al trentesimo mi ha fatto saltare dal divano. Poi Pio, poi Beier: che serata.

replies.text: Maignan deserved credit even while losing.

milan-san-siro-beier-91-match-report-oct.text: Olise released Pio at 14 and for a second I thought we were ahead. Offside by a whisker. I still feel robbed.

replies.text: Offside is offside, even if it ruins your evening.
Pio saved his real celebration for minute 68.

milan-san-siro-beier-91-match-report-oct.text: Vittoria enorme. Però le occasioni si devono trasformare prima: un portiere come Maignan ti fa soffrire fino alla fine.

replies.text: Yes. We manufactured enough pressure, but finishing earlier would be kinder to everyone.

milan-san-siro-beier-91-match-report-oct.text: Avere Maignan così e perdere comunque è da non credere. McTominay sempre lì dove fa male.

replies.text: I will be framing that compliment.
La difesa si deve svegliare.

milan-san-siro-beier-91-match-report-oct.text: I requested an uneventful clean-sheet win and was sent 2–1 at San Siro in the rain. The complaints office is closed.

replies.text: The complaints office has been scoring in stoppage time.

milan-san-siro-beier-91-match-report-oct.text: He scored in the 68th. Could he not have respected the posted 60-minute deadline?

replies.text: He literally equalised away to Milan.
You invented a 60-minute deadline and are now citing it as law. The goal at 68 still counts.

milan-san-siro-beier-91-match-report-oct.text: Il campionato dice due gol subiti in sei partite. In Europa ne abbiamo presi tre dal Leverkusen. Entrambe le cose sono vere.

replies.text: E bisogna continuare a lavorare.

milan-san-siro-beier-91-match-report-oct.text: The rain, the San Siro lights, Rabiot thinking he had won it, and then Beier. I need this result tattooed onto my brain.

replies.text: Meglio una sciarpa. Meno dolore.

milan-san-siro-beier-91-match-report-oct.text: 16 from 18 available. Five wins, one draw. Nine for, two against. Four clean sheets. I double-checked it while shaking.

replies.text: Can your spreadsheet measure emotional damage?
Keep checking it. Sixteen points from eighteen sounds better every time I hear it.

milan-san-siro-beier-91-match-report-oct.text: Everyone demanded a response after Leverkusen. A 2–1 league win at Milan is a result I will take all day.

replies.text: Still conceded once.
A response at San Siro after Leverkusen is exactly the kind of win supporters are allowed to enjoy without qualification.

milan-san-siro-beier-91-match-report-oct.text: The 14th-minute flag and the 40th-minute stop could have crushed him. He still got us back level.

replies.text: I am drafting an attendance warning.
If every offside and saved chance becomes part of the Pio defence file, you are going to need a second hard drive.

milan-san-siro-beier-91-match-report-oct.text: Scott contro il Milan: due passaggi decisivi. Prima Pio e poi Beier. Altro che fortuna!

replies.text: Il tabellino non mente. Due assist.

milan-san-siro-beier-91-match-report-oct.text: Maronna mia, 'stu Napoli nun tene pietà. San Siro zittito all’ultimo respiro!

replies.text: Questa ce la ricordiamo per anni.

milan-san-siro-beier-91-match-report-oct.text: After that 3–3 on Tuesday I wanted a quiet recovery match. Milan away said no.

replies.text: We have not played a quiet match since the calendar was invented.

milan-san-siro-beier-91-match-report-oct.text: Quattro gol in campionato, sei in tutte le competizioni. E non stiamo neanche a novembre!

replies.text: Preciso: quattro in Serie A, due in Champions.

milan-san-siro-beier-91-match-report-oct.text: Can we appreciate that Paz forced one of the biggest saves of the half? No goal contribution but real danger.

replies.text: And the ball to Pio for the flagged finish deserves context too.

milan-san-siro-beier-91-match-report-oct.text: I am not even mad about Maignan. He made the saves. We failed him after the Rabiot goal.

replies.text: Exactly. A lead at home and still no points.

milan-san-siro-beier-91-match-report-oct.text: Wet away match against a rival is the kind you circle before the season. Six games unbeaten. I am smiling.

replies.text: I am trying to trust happiness.

milan-san-siro-beier-91-match-report-oct.text: Dopo il Leverkusen serviva carattere. Vincere a Milano così è una risposta forte.

replies.text: E la prossima volta magari senza infarto!

milan-san-siro-beier-91-match-report-oct.text: Remember when they said all our goals were late because we were lucky? Now it is three matches of fighting until the end.

replies.text: Character is repeated. That still does not make the earlier chances irrelevant.

milan-san-siro-beier-91-match-report-oct.text: Maignan at 30 against Paz was outrageous. Good keepers can make you feel cursed. Winning anyway says something.

replies.text: Nico was unlucky not to have his name on the score sheet.

milan-san-siro-beier-91-match-report-oct.text: Non posso credere che Maignan ci tenga in piedi e poi Beier segni al 91. Che rabbia.

replies.text: Questo fa molto più male di una sconfitta netta.

milan-san-siro-beier-91-match-report-oct.text: We turned 0–1 into 2–1 at one of the hardest away grounds. Do not reduce this to “lucky late goal.”

replies.text: Exactly, but the work still continues.

milan-san-siro-beier-91-match-report-oct.text: Pio scores: I cheer. Beier scores: I forget how to operate a chair. This club is a medical event.

replies.text: I have been compiling a risk assessment since Como.

milan-san-siro-beier-91-match-report-oct.text: Quando Rabiot segna al 55 penso che il San Siro basti. Macché. McTominay ci ha rovinato la serata.

replies.text: Due assist. Un saluto.

milan-san-siro-beier-91-match-report-oct.text: No invented heroics. We know the 14th-minute offside, Maignan’s stops, Rabiot 55, Pio 68, Beier 90+1. That is more than enough drama.

replies.text: The real sequence needs no embellishment.

mctominay-two-assists-milan-big-game-oct.text: Due assist in una sola serata contro il Milan. Scott, sei un mostro.

replies.text: La maglia sudata vale doppio a San Siro.

mctominay-two-assists-milan-big-game-oct.text: League assists: Lecce, Como, Pio at Milan, Beier at Milan. Champions League: Beier against Leverkusen. Five total.

replies.text: Thank you. Never count the Torino assist without confirmation.

mctominay-two-assists-milan-big-game-oct.text: People act like McTominay only searches for Beier. He found Pio for the goal that changed this match.

replies.text: And still came back to Beier for the winner. Everybody eats.

mctominay-two-assists-milan-big-game-oct.text: When Scott has the ball late, I automatically scan for Beier now.

replies.text: The opposition should probably start doing that too.

mctominay-two-assists-milan-big-game-oct.text: Two different game states. Down 1–0 on 68; level 1–1 on 91. Same creator. That is what the analysis gets right.

replies.text: A pass to save a point, a pass to win three.

mctominay-two-assists-milan-big-game-oct.text: Non serve inventarsi un taglio, un cross o un filtrante. Il dato sicuro è semplice: McTominay ha servito entrambi.

replies.text: Finally someone reads the record instead of drawing arrows from imagination.

mctominay-two-assists-milan-big-game-oct.text: I am willing to award Scott the assist but Pio should file his goal ten minutes sooner next time.

replies.text: You would issue a fine to a stopwatch.

mctominay-two-assists-milan-big-game-oct.text: Nico had Maignan in trouble at 30, even without a goal. Please don’t write him out of the match.

replies.text: Agreed. Not every strong moment shows up as G/A.

mctominay-two-assists-milan-big-game-oct.text: McTominay due assist. Noi due gol presi. Non mi fate vedere altri numeri.

replies.text: Capisco, ma io ne ho molti altri.

mctominay-two-assists-milan-big-game-oct.text: The final ball under pressure matters more than the loudest celebration. Scott earned every bit of this.

replies.text: Keep that energy.

mctominay-two-assists-milan-big-game-oct.text: In tre settimane Scott ci ha dato punti a Como, in Champions e adesso pure al Milan. Che giocatore.

replies.text: Però a Leverkusen abbiamo pareggiato: un punto recuperato, non tre vinti.

mctominay-two-assists-milan-big-game-oct.text: Is this going to be used as an excuse to never discuss the chances we wasted before halftime?

replies.text: No. That would be a different analysis. This one is about the verified assists.

mctominay-two-assists-milan-big-game-oct.text: Pio già tre gol in Serie A, uno in Champions. Ma chiamatelo pure una riserva.

replies.text: Or call him one of our important forwards and enjoy both.

mctominay-two-assists-milan-big-game-oct.text: Beier was involved in all three against Leverkusen and now scores the winner. He is not a luxury player.

replies.text: Nobody sensible argues that.

mctominay-two-assists-milan-big-game-oct.text: After Rabiot scored, all we needed was to keep Scott quiet. We did precisely the opposite.

replies.text: I have no counterargument.

mctominay-two-assists-milan-big-game-oct.text: As much as I enjoy a passing diagram, credit should be on the registered assist, not the player who last touched it in midfield.

replies.text: Correct. Ask me about Leverkusen for evidence.

mctominay-two-assists-milan-big-game-oct.text: Five assists in six league games? No. Four league plus one European. I will correct my own excitement.

replies.text: Growth. Genuine personal growth.

mctominay-two-assists-milan-big-game-oct.text: Olise e Pio al 14 erano a un soffio dal gol. Fuorigioco, però il segnale c’era.

replies.text: Poi il segnale è diventato gol al 68.

mctominay-two-assists-milan-big-game-oct.text: We are discussing Scott’s distribution statistics as if he is a postal worker who delivers screaming.

replies.text: Express shipping to San Siro.

mctominay-two-assists-milan-big-game-oct.text: The crucial thing: Pio’s equaliser changes the match, Beier’s winner changes the points. Scott created both.

replies.text: Exactly. No need to pit the two forwards against each other.

mctominay-two-assists-milan-big-game-oct.text: Due gol, stesso assistman, vittoria a Milano. È una firma di qualità.

replies.text: La firma la mette Scott!

mctominay-two-assists-milan-big-game-oct.text: Beier 6 goals and 2 assists overall, Pio 4 and 1, Scott 5 assists. That is our updated confirmed ledger.

replies.text: Lovely. Now let’s beat Roma.

milan-maignan-napoli-mentalita-opinion-o.text: La vittoria è bellissima. Ma lasciare Rabiot segnare e poi sperare nel 91 non può essere l’unico piano.

replies.text: Non è stato il piano: abbiamo creato prima, e Maignan ha parato.

milan-maignan-napoli-mentalita-opinion-o.text: Vincere a San Siro sotto la pioggia al 91 non si critica. Si racconta ai nipoti.

replies.text: Possiamo fare entrambe le cose.

milan-maignan-napoli-mentalita-opinion-o.text: This is unsustainable. You cannot score at 90+ every time.

replies.text: I agree. But please wait until tomorrow to be miserable.
Beier has already put that theory under review.

milan-maignan-napoli-mentalita-opinion-o.text: Winning is worse for my stress now because it happens at the exact moment I give up.

replies.text: Statistically your giving up is a renewable resource.

milan-maignan-napoli-mentalita-opinion-o.text: Two Serie A goals conceded in six games matters. Don’t let the Leverkusen night erase the domestic defending.

replies.text: Also don’t let league numbers erase what happened against Leverkusen. Both.

milan-maignan-napoli-mentalita-opinion-o.text: La squadra di casa avanti al 55 e poi battuta al 91. Noi dobbiamo farci delle domande, non loro.

replies.text: Non avrei saputo dirlo meglio.

milan-maignan-napoli-mentalita-opinion-o.text: Maignan was outstanding and still lost. I am tired of watching their striker celebrate late.

replies.text: Unfortunately for you he seems quite fond of it.

milan-maignan-napoli-mentalita-opinion-o.text: Basta dire che vince solo Beier. Senza Pio al 68 non c’è la vittoria al 91.

replies.text: True. And without Beier’s goal it ends a draw. They both matter.

milan-maignan-napoli-mentalita-opinion-o.text: If Beier does this one more time, I genuinely want him tested for access to an alternate clock.

replies.text: His wristwatch only has 88, 91 and 92 printed on it.

milan-maignan-napoli-mentalita-opinion-o.text: Il confronto con il Leverkusen è inevitabile, ma oggi portiamo via tre punti da Milano. Guardiamo avanti.

replies.text: Esatto. La risposta concreta vale più delle promesse.

milan-maignan-napoli-mentalita-opinion-o.text: There is a difference between late reliance and sustained threat. Paz’s and Pio’s earlier chances suggest the latter too.

replies.text: Yes. We did not manufacture the danger only at 90+1.

milan-maignan-napoli-mentalita-opinion-o.text: Anche senza gol, Paz ha costretto Maignan a una parata enorme. Le partite sono più del tabellino.

replies.text: And Maignan deserves credit.

milan-maignan-napoli-mentalita-opinion-o.text: That 14th-minute offside was a millimetre away from a completely different match story.

replies.text: A marginal offside still counts as offside.

milan-maignan-napoli-mentalita-opinion-o.text: 16 points after six, 9 scored, 2 conceded, +7. For a supposedly anxious title defence that looks rather good.

replies.text: Numbers do not remove the need for a performance review.

milan-maignan-napoli-mentalita-opinion-o.text: The writers are making two cases at once: resilience and unnecessary suffering. That is just being a Napoli supporter.

replies.text: Se vuoi tranquillità, hai sbagliato squadra.

milan-maignan-napoli-mentalita-opinion-o.text: Parliamo del carattere quanto vogliamo, ma il dato è Scott due assist. Serve anche qualità per rimontare.

replies.text: Questo sì. Non è soltanto fortuna.

milan-maignan-napoli-mentalita-opinion-o.text: As a strict critic I cannot endorse a victory occurring without more than two goals.

replies.text: You have been fully defeated by the concept of football.

milan-maignan-napoli-mentalita-opinion-o.text: San Siro. Rain. Behind after halftime. Stoppage-time winner. Some days you just let the result feel enormous.

replies.text: Exactly. The film room can wait a few hours.

milan-maignan-napoli-mentalita-opinion-o.text: Quattro punti in Champions, sedici in campionato. Non perfetti, ma questa squadra non smette mai di crederci.

replies.text: Tutti dati confermati.

milan-maignan-napoli-mentalita-opinion-o.text: E chi dorme stanotte? Io no. A San Siro abbiamo fatto festa al novantunesimo!

replies.text: I will be awake reviewing all of my terrible predictions.

italy-friendly-double-pio-kean-oct-2028.text: Due vittorie, due porte inviolate. Bene. Però sono amichevoli, non facciamo già i titoli sui Mondiali.

replies.text: Giusto. Però quattro gol tutti con Pio coinvolto fanno piacere.

italy-friendly-double-pio-kean-oct-2028.text: Due gol contro la Costa d’Avorio, due assist per Kean contro la Tunisia. Il ragazzo sa fare tutto.

replies.text: E Kean le ha messe dentro tutte e due. Diamo credito anche a lui.

italy-friendly-double-pio-kean-oct-2028.text: Friendly window totals: Pio 2G 2A, Kean 2G. These numbers are not added to Napoli's club stats.

replies.text: Thank you. And we do not know the goal minutes.

italy-friendly-double-pio-kean-oct-2028.text: Moise con una doppietta, Pio con i due passaggi decisivi. Finalmente possono giocare per aiutarsi, non per litigare su chi è il nove.

replies.text: Esatto. Una coppia, non una guerra di tifoserie.

italy-friendly-double-pio-kean-oct-2028.text: Two comfortable scorelines. I don't know what to do without a stoppage-time crisis.

replies.text: Save your anxiety for Roma away.

italy-friendly-double-pio-kean-oct-2028.text: Pio cu 'a maglia azzurra e cu chella 'e Napule. Sempre orgoglio.

replies.text: In campo fa parlare i numeri, pure quando si tratta di amichevoli.

italy-friendly-double-pio-kean-oct-2028.text: A useful window for combinations, not a meaningful stress test. Nothing wrong with saying both.

replies.text: Four for and zero against. Nice, but not a tournament forecast.

italy-friendly-double-pio-kean-oct-2028.text: Why are we applauding friendlies when Napoli have Roma next?

replies.text: Nessuno sta organizzando la parata. È solo una buona notizia.
Roma is the real competitive test. The useful takeaway from these friendlies is that Pio and Kean found combinations without adding international numbers to Napoli’s ledger.

roma-ends-44-match-run-oct-2028.text: QUARANTAQUATTRO. FINE. Mi fa male, ma che viaggio incredibile abbiamo fatto.

replies.text: I thought I was ready for this eventually. I was wrong.
Una sconfitta non cancella quarantaquattro partite. Ricordate il viaggio prima di giudicare la caduta.

roma-ends-44-match-run-oct-2028.text: PISILLI! Una palla sporca da calcio d'angolo e finisce la serie. Questa la ricorderemo.

replies.text: Festeggia pure. Oggi avete vinto voi.
Alla fine contano i tre punti. Daje!

roma-ends-44-match-run-oct-2028.text: IT HAPPENED. THE PROPHECY. THE STREAK IS DEAD. I don't know what to do with my hands.

replies.text: Maybe put down the emergency megaphone.
You still have 16 league points, for what it's worth.

roma-ends-44-match-run-oct-2028.text: Forty-four matches without losing and THIS is how it ends? A scramble from a corner? Questions for the manager immediately.

replies.text: Questions, yes. Pitchforks, no.
You waited 44 matches to post this, didn't you?

roma-ends-44-match-run-oct-2028.text: Il primo pallone su corner conta. Il secondo ancora di più. La rete di Pisilli nasce da una mischia: bisogna studiarla.

replies.text: Exactly. Analyse the phase, not randomly blame one defender.
At least someone is asking for accountability.

roma-ends-44-match-run-oct-2028.text: The cruel part is I kept waiting for 90+1 like the match owed us another Beier goal.

replies.text: It never owed us one. We got spoiled.
My brain had already booked the comeback.

roma-ends-44-match-run-oct-2028.text: Pio scores twice for Italy, returns, and our league streak ends. Nobody better try to turn that into his fault.

replies.text: I was halfway through writing a ridiculous theory.
Anyone blaming Pio for a corner conceded after an international break is looking for a scapegoat, not an explanation.

roma-ends-44-match-run-oct-2028.text: 2027–28: 28W 10D 0L. This season before Roma: 5W 1D. That's 44 unbeaten Serie A games. The 45th ended it.

replies.text: Happy to help with your counting.
Forty-four unbeaten written as one line was beautiful. I was not emotionally prepared to add the loss column.

roma-ends-44-match-run-oct-2028.text: The headlines will be about your streak. In Rome we're talking about Pisilli.

replies.text: Fair enough. He scored the winner.
Exactly. Give the scorer his due.

roma-ends-44-match-run-oct-2028.text: Can we PLEASE not decide who was at fault for that corner without a proper replay? We know it was a scramble. That's it.

replies.text: Yes. Team set-piece review first.
Someone has to own the problem eventually.

roma-ends-44-match-run-oct-2028.text: Zero comeback today. I kept waiting for Scott to deliver the last pass. We cannot demand he saves every fixture.

replies.text: It had started to feel automatic.
That expectation is itself a problem.

roma-ends-44-match-run-oct-2028.text: I survived an invincible season, Milan at 90+1, Leverkusen at 90+2, and the thing that breaks me is one scrappy corner.

replies.text: I had a commemorative calendar ready.
Keep the calendar. Burn the part where Roma score from that corner.

roma-ends-44-match-run-oct-2028.text: One goal conceded, none scored. That is enough to explain the result without pretending we know the shot map.

replies.text: Exactly. Don't invent a siege in either direction.
The database has exactly one confirmed scorer.

roma-ends-44-match-run-oct-2028.text: A Roma aspettavamo questa occasione. Pisilli segna, il Napoli cade. Daje Roma!

replies.text: Rispetto. Ma la stagione è lunga.

roma-ends-44-match-run-oct-2028.text: Three goals conceded in seven Serie A matches is still excellent. One badly dealt-with set piece can still lose you the game.

replies.text: Both truths need to survive the headlines.
Yes. Aggregate numbers never defend a corner by themselves.

roma-ends-44-match-run-oct-2028.text: I sat through the invincible year telling myself we could not keep this forever. Still gutted when the full-time whistle came.

replies.text: È normale. Ma è anche orgoglio.

roma-ends-44-match-run-oct-2028.text: Did anyone inform the league that Napoli's unbeaten status was mandatory? Can we submit paperwork?

replies.text: The appeal deadline was the final whistle.
Your paperwork is not serious.

roma-ends-44-match-run-oct-2028.text: Niente gol al novantunesimo stavolta. Però 44 partite imbattuti non le può cancellare la Roma.

replies.text: Bravo. Domani ripartiamo.

roma-ends-44-match-run-oct-2028.text: The worst part of losing is all the invented post-match takes about who should have started and what every player did.

replies.text: We don't have an XI or performance breakdown from this game. Keep it grounded.

roma-ends-44-match-run-oct-2028.text: Tutti aspettavano il solito gol di Beier nei minuti di recupero. Oggi il risultato non si muove.

replies.text: I'm going to choose to believe you typed that nervously.

roma-ends-44-match-run-oct-2028.text: When you go unbeaten for an entire season, people forget losing is a thing football teams can actually do.

replies.text: I was in denial until approximately five seconds after full time.

roma-ends-44-match-run-oct-2028.text: Updated record: 7 played, 5 wins, 1 draw, 1 loss. Sixteen points. Nine scored, three conceded. +6.

replies.text: Numbers don't score goals.
Sixteen points after seven is not a collapse. The unbeaten run ending hurts, but the season did not end with it.

roma-ends-44-match-run-oct-2028.text: Una sconfitta non trasforma questa squadra in una squadra scarsa. La risposta arriverà dal lavoro.

replies.text: Appunto. Dopo una sconfitta si lavora.

roma-ends-44-match-run-oct-2028.text: Slavia Prague is next. That is where the response has to come, not in another two days of outrage online.

replies.text: A European night to reset the mood.
I am requesting a boring win this time.

roma-ends-44-match-run-oct-2028.text: The media should ask about defending corners, not hide behind 44 matches of nostalgia.

replies.text: That is a fair question. Just don't pretend it requires sacking somebody.
You absolutely drafted the headline before full time. At least admit the corner gives you one real question to ask.
